scenes.text: {reporter.name}: 'Sources tell me {promotion} is finalizing {subject.first} {subject.last} vs. a top contender for next month.' You haven't even called {subject.first}'s manager yet. You were going to do that after lunch.
scenes.speaker: {reporter.name}

choices.label: Confirm it to save face
choices.result: You confirm. He thanks you for confirming. He already knew.

choices.label: Change the fight just to make him wrong
choices.result: You book something else entirely. He tweets 'Plans changed. Sources tell me it's because I reported it.' He's right.

choices.label: Ban him
choices.result: Banned. You feel great for about four minutes.

scenes.text: THE PRESIDENT BANNED A REPORTER FOR REPORTING. Every outlet, including the ones that hate {reporter.name}, runs it. Three fighters post 'Free {reporter.last}' T-shirts. Somebody is selling the T-shirts.

choices.label: Unban him and pretend it never happened
choices.result: Unbanned. He tweets a single word: 'Sources.'

choices.label: Keep the ban
choices.result: You keep the ban. His scoops get MORE accurate. Someone inside is feeding him.

scenes.text: {reporter.name} on the line, unusually polite. 'Hey, I'd love to get something before anyone else this week. Off the record, anything you can give me?'
scenes.speaker: {reporter.name}

choices.label: Feed him a real exclusive
choices.result: He breaks it with 'I'm told by a source with direct knowledge'. You are the direct knowledge. It feels weirdly great.

choices.label: Feed him a fake story to burn him
choices.result: He reports a fight that doesn't exist. He finds out within hours. He will never forget.

choices.label: Nothing today
choices.result: 'Understood.' He'll get it from someone else.

scenes.text: Every confidential decision this month has leaked within an hour. Legal recommends an internal investigation. Suspects: the matchmaker, your assistant, the cutman coordinator, and a guy named Rick nobody remembers hiring.
scenes.speaker: The Board
scenes.title: MEMO: CONFIDENTIAL (LOL)

choices.label: Plant different fake info with each suspect
choices.result: The canary trap is set. Four suspects, four different fake stories about a fight with a bear.

choices.label: Drop it
choices.result: The leaks continue. Rick gets a promotion.

scenes.text: {reporter.name} has reported that 'the promotion is negotiating a fight with a bear'. Only one person was told the bear story: Rick. Nobody remembers hiring Rick. Rick, it turns out, is {reporter.name}'s cousin.
scenes.title: INTERNAL INVESTIGATION REPORT

choices.label: Fire Rick
choices.result: Rick is escorted out. He takes a stapler and a framed photo of you that he apparently kept on his desk.

choices.label: Keep Rick and use him to feed stories
choices.result: Rick becomes a double agent. He's surprisingly good at it. He asks for a raise.

scenes.text: Dear {president}: I'm {reporter.name} from {reporter.outlet}. I'm working on a story about {promotion}'s treatment of fighters, its finances, and several 'buried' documents. I'd welcome your comment. I have 48 hours of questions. Kind regards.
scenes.title: EMAIL

choices.label: Sit down for a full interview
choices.result: You talk for two hours. You say 'off the record' nine times. It is not off the record.

choices.label: 'No comment'
choices.result: '{promotion} declined to comment.' The classic.

choices.label: Threaten to sue
choices.result: The legal threat becomes paragraph one of the story.

scenes.text: INVESTIGATION, PART 1 OF 4: Inside {promotion}, where paperwork goes to die. Former staff describe a filing system of 'shredder, drawer, or the President's car'. Twelve sources. Photographs. A diagram.

choices.label: Release a rebuttal
choices.result: Your rebuttal has eleven typos. They screenshot every one.

choices.label: Announce an independent compliance review
choices.result: A compliance firm arrives. They wear identical blue suits. They find more than you hoped.

scenes.text: INVESTIGATION, PART 2 OF 4: The Money. How {promotion} pays fighters 15% of revenue while the President's lifestyle includes, per receipts, 'a jet ski, a second jet ski, and a jet ski for the jet ski'.

choices.label: Raise minimum purses immediately
choices.result: You raise minimum purses before Part 3. The reporter notes this in Part 3, generously.

choices.label: Ride it out
choices.result: Two more parts. Deep breaths.

scenes.text: INVESTIGATION, PART 3 OF 4: The Damage. Former fighters describe memory loss, unpaid medical bills, and a promotion that 'treated brain scans like optional paperwork'. This part is not funny. It isn't meant to be.

choices.label: Fund a retired fighters' health program
choices.result: You fund it. Fully. Some things are just right.

choices.label: Issue a statement about 'risk being inherent'
choices.result: The statement is accurate and terrible.

scenes.text: INVESTIGATION, PART 4 OF 4: The Boss. A portrait of {president}. Loud, chaotic, occasionally generous, frequently reckless. 'He's not evil,' one source says. 'He's just never once read a document.'

choices.label: Frame it and hang it in the office
choices.result: 'Never once read a document' is now printed on a T-shirt you wear to weigh-ins.

choices.label: Sue for defamation
choices.result: It goes nowhere. Truth is a defense. Many things in the article are true.

scenes.text: Joe Brogan wants you on the podcast. 'Four hours, man, totally relaxed. We'll talk fights, elk meat, the pyramids, it's entirely possible we talk about DMT.'
scenes.speaker: Joe Brogan's producer

choices.label: Do the podcast
choices.result: You say something you shouldn't around hour three. Nobody notices because Joe is showing a picture of a chimpanzee ripping a guy's face off.

choices.label: Send your best fighter instead
choices.result: {subject.first} goes on for three hours and becomes a mainstream celebrity overnight.

scenes.text: Braille Sonnen posted a 40-minute video breaking down {subject.first} {subject.last}'s last fight. He describes '{subject.last}'s beautiful southpaw stance' ({subject.last} is orthodox) and the 'gorgeous blue shorts' (they were red). At the end, he leans into the camera and says: 'I don't actually know what I'm talking about. I can't see shit.' 3 million views.
scenes.speaker: Braille Sonnen

choices.label: Share it on the official account
choices.result: The official account shares it with the caption 'he's not wrong (he is wrong)'. Engagement goes through the roof.

choices.label: Hire Braille for the broadcast team
choices.result: Braille joins the booth. His first call: 'And THAT is a beautiful left hook' during a takedown. He's an instant cult hero.

scenes.text: Braille Sonnen is live on air predicting your next main event. 'I've studied the tape. Well, I've listened to the tape. {subject.last} wins by flying knee in round one, then retires to raise llamas. Mark it down.' Betting lines are moving because of this.
scenes.speaker: Braille Sonnen

choices.label: Call in live and play along
choices.result: You call in. Braille says 'Who's this? Sounds bald.' Iconic.

choices.label: Ask the betting sites to ignore him
choices.result: They don't. Braille is now the most influential handicapper in the sport.

scenes.text: Braille Sonnen did a 12-minute backstage interview with {subject.first} {subject.last}. It was a janitor. The janitor answered every question and announced he wants a title shot. The clip is the most-viewed thing your promotion posted all year.
scenes.speaker: Braille Sonnen

choices.label: Give the janitor a prelim fight
choices.result: The janitor loses in 40 seconds and gets a fight-night bonus anyway, from the fans, via GoFundMe.

choices.label: Just enjoy it
choices.result: Pure content.

scenes.text: Camera Guy Dave from TMZee is outside the steakhouse as you leave. 'YO PREZ! Quick question! Is it true {subject.first} {subject.last} cried during weigh-ins? Do YOU cry? When did you last cry? Can you cry now?'
scenes.speaker: Camera Guy Dave

choices.label: 'Everybody cries, Dave.'
choices.result: 'Everybody cries, Dave' becomes a meme and a T-shirt.

choices.label: Push past him
choices.result: The push is captioned 'PREZ GETS PHYSICAL'. It was a shoulder brush.

title: TruthBomb Live Says It Was Rigged

scenes.text: Rex Bunkerman of TruthBomb Live is streaming a frame-by-frame 'investigation' proving your last main event was scripted. His evidence: 'Why would a guy fall down if he wasn't paid to?' 400,000 people are watching.

choices.label: Ignore him
choices.result: He streams for 9 hours. Ad revenue: impressive.

choices.label: Invite him to the next event
choices.result: He attends wearing a tinfoil lanyard. He watches a KO from cageside, goes pale, and admits 'that one seemed real'.

scenes.text: An anonymous Undergrowth forum post claims {subject.first} {subject.last} is 'secretly retiring to become a professional bowler'. It has 900 replies. {subject.last}'s mother called {his} coach to ask about bowling.

choices.label: Deny it
choices.result: You deny it. The forum now believes it more.

choices.label: Book {him} a bowling sponsorship
choices.result: {He} bowls a 74 on a sponsored stream. The rumor is now partially true.

scenes.text: {subject.first} {subject.last} called {reporter.name} 'a fat nerd with a lanyard' after a mildly critical article. {reporter.name} responded with {subject.last}'s full record against southpaws. It's brutal. {subject.last} has gone very quiet.

choices.label: Make {subject.first} apologize
choices.result: The apology is three words long. Two of them are 'my bad'.

choices.label: Book {subject.first} on a podcast to respond
choices.result: The response podcast is two hours of {subject.first} reading the article aloud and saying 'nah'.

scenes.text: The Purse Report has published your entire roster's salaries in a sortable spreadsheet. Column H is labelled 'what they should be paid'. Column I is labelled 'what the President's boat cost'.

choices.label: Commission an independent pay study
choices.result: The study concludes you should pay fighters more. You knew. You paid for the knowing.

choices.label: Call it fake news
choices.result: It isn't fake. Column I is especially not fake.
